  <div class="l-area aligned">  <div class="l-rows l-rows--gap l-rows--left">  <div class="l-area">  <div class="text text--auto">
    <div class="section-heading aligned l-area " data-zuu-reveal="children">
  <h3 class="heading-title aligned type--heading-md">Cottage 4+1 standard</h3>
    </div>
